content: Written 2026-10-06 18:10, self-approved (user rule 'run automatically, don't wait'). Code c5fef9f = 457de84 (real row 4 v2) + R2 first-echo snapshot readout (every row) + A1 GaME detect_additions as published in every row (render on the map of now under T1). Per-state binding is NOT in it (offline GT-worse, records row of 17:40-18:12). Jobs, one at a time: (1) smoke real A->B->C, 300 frames per session, row 4 flags as v2; eval_row.sh on it; (2) smoke synthetic A->B, 300 frames, row 4; eval_row.sh on it; (3) only if both smokes pass: real row 4 full (A, then B+C with --resume), eval_row.sh, six claims appended.

--backend game --row 4 --core l2 --d1 --g5 --inside --g5-reference render (as real_row4v2, row4v2_commit.txt); GAME_CONFIG=flat.yaml (real); synthetic: no GAME_CONFIG (as every synthetic GaME row). Run from a git archive of c5fef9f (runs/.../code_c5fef9f), as queue11.

First echo = the Gaussian at which transmittance T first drops to <= 0.5 along the ray: its depth is the 3DGS rasterizer's median depth (ul_rasterizer_v2 forward.cu, the median crossing, the same depth the median-depth TSDF export uses); its identity labels the pixel (M1a: a label belongs to the surface the reading's endpoint lies on). Replaces E1 (class-id variance < 0.25, 5% jump: thresholds of ours without source). Validated offline on v2 (records 2026-10-06, readout check): D2 FPs 0, D3 AB 15/0/3, BC 9/0/3.

GaME src/entities/game.py:283-296 detect_additions = _find_added_geometry_masks (198-232, with our C5: measured-depth pixels only) + _propagate_addition_occlusions (235-280: occlusion masks in covisible keyframes, ignored_frames when coverage > covis_ignore_threshold). Thresholds from flat.yaml unchanged (depth_change_threshold 3.0, addition_coverage_threshold 0.4, covis_ignore_threshold 1.0). User/supervisor 10-06: official mapping, only the removal decision is the layer's.

Khronos eq. 5: the measurement at t is generated by the map of t. R2 renders the map of time t (alive_at(t)) and reads the surface the ray reaches. A1: GaME's addition test compares the new keyframe with GaME's current model; GaME prunes what it removes, so its current model = the map of now; under T1 ended Gaussians are kept for history, hence the test renders alive_at(now). Its occlusion masks remove pixels of older keyframes from training where new geometry is in front; under T1 those keyframes already do not render the new state, so A1 only removes supervision (published behaviour, kept, not altered).

R2: depth = median / scale (m), pixels with measured depth only (C4), identity = identity of the median Gaussian (clamped >= 0), 2 cm background / 1 cm object voxels as before. A1: depth difference in GaME scene units vs depth_change_threshold (scene units, as published); masks = the keyframe's instance + semantic components (GameBackend._masks, as before).

Every row's snapshots use R2 (row 3 is re-evaluated by re-emission with --readout first_echo, row 1 likewise, before the rows are put side by side); eval chain = eval_row.sh unchanged (G1 surfel + median TSDF, G2, D2/D3, ghost, retention + retention_correct, Object F1 Table 1 variant, D1 person). No new number in the model. The stop-rule tolerance 0.5 pp is a decision tolerance of the comparison (as in the item-2 review), not a model parameter.
smoke dirs smoke_c5fef9f_real / smoke_c5fef9f_syn and real_row4v3: checkpoints a/b/c, timelines, layer logs, run.json, eval_real / eval_syn, logs; runs/.../code_c5fef9f archive.

Each mapping step exit 0; sessions a/b/c (synthetic a/b) have timeline.pkl and checkpoint_<s>.pt; eval_row.sh writes eval_done.txt and, real: geometry/{a,b,c}/G1.json and G1_tsdf.json, changes/{b,c}/STATE_CHANGE_SUMMARY.csv, ghost/{b,c}/GHOST.json, retention_{b,c}.json, objects/{a,b,c}/weighted_nr; synthetic: eval_syn summary files and objects. No metric threshold on a 300-frame smoke (chain check only). Any miss: stop, fix the cause, re-smoke; row 4 does not start.

GPU: nothing else on it (18:1x: 0.5 GB used, TSDF runner idle); real row 4 v2 peaked 14.7/16.3 GB in the refinement, A1 adds no GPU state beyond masks; gate_run2.sh pauses the job if the TSDF runner starts; GPU.lock. RAM 42 GB available, checkpoints ~4 GB each, disk 589 GB free. Durations: smoke real ~30 min, synthetic ~20 min, evals ~20 min each, real row 4 ~2 h + eval ~40 min. OOM: one unchanged rerun (queue rule), else stop.

item: real row 4 c5fef9f vs v2 first echo (offline re-emission of v2, same readout)
content: The only mapping change is A1. Prediction: small effect, since T1 already keeps older keyframes from rendering new states: surfel G1@5 P and R of B and C within 1 pp of v2 first echo (P B 82.66 / C 80.16, R 96.57 / 97.06); D2 FP 0; D3 FN <= 3 per pair (AB 15/0/3, BC 9/0/3); ghost C <= 15.0; unobserved retention B >= 84.8 (85.79 - 1).

GT-worse than v2 first echo: P or R lower by > 0.5 pp on B or C, ghost B or C higher by > 0.5, any D2 FP, D3 FN > 3 on a pair, or unobserved retention lower by > 1 pp -> A1 is reverted (git revert of its lines), the cause recorded, and the next row runs without it. Not GT-worse -> row 3 re-evaluated with the first echo, real row 1, synthetic rows 4/1/3, 4D node export.
